blurb: The City of Bastrop's Convention & Exhibit Center is the perfect corporate event facility in Central Texas. Located in the charming Historic District, our convenient location is only a 25-minute drive from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport. Our 26,000-square-foot space includes flexible ballrooms, four meeting rooms, two large patios, outdoor venue space, and 316 complimentary on-site parking spots.
